On this machine, a fresh worktree triggers esp-idf-sys's first-time network bootstrap (git clone of esp-idf + python venv + constraints-file download), which hit two environment issues unrelated to the code: a transient GitHub 502 on submodule fetch (retry fixed it), and a Python (pyenv 3.13.9) SSL CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED on the constraints download that 'pip install certifi' + SSL_CERT_FILE did NOT fix (the idf_tools.py venv's urllib doesn't pick it up). Worked around by symlinking .worktrees/.../\.embuild -> the main checkout's already-bootstrapped .embuild (gitignored either way, so this is a pure local dev convenience, not part of the shipped change). Future agents hitting the same SSL error on a fresh worktree should look for an existing .embuild in a sibling checkout before debugging Python cert config from scratch." 2>&1 | tail -3
Completed: split single crate into a 3-member Cargo workspace (core=bhk-core, firmware, emulator) per the portability-boundary ADR. VaultItem view-model migrated to core with placeholder DisplaySurface/InputSource/Clock/Storage/SyncSource/NavIntent seams (no impls, no SdkSyncSource). Old gui/simple_gui engines preserved, duplicated across firmware+emulator (pruned to input-only in emulator's gui/ copy since only firmware's view.rs uses the full old engine). Both cargo build -p firmware (xtensa, sourced export-esp.sh) and cargo build --bin desktop --target aarch64-apple-darwin (host) build and link successfully; the json_to_cbor example was smoke-tested end to end." 2>&1 | tail -3

embedded-graphics-framebuf 0.5.0 only ships FrameBufferBackend impls for fixed-size arrays ([C;N]/&mut [C;N]), not Vec<C> (and can't be added downstream due to orphan rules - both the trait and Vec are foreign). Solution: a local newtype (HeapBuffer(Vec<Rgb565>)) implementing FrameBufferBackend, which keeps FrameBuffer565's resolution a runtime parameter instead of a compile-time const generic. Also: DrawTargetExt::clipped(&area) does NOT translate coordinates into area-relative space, it only clips - widgets must still draw in absolute framebuffer coordinates offset by area.top_left." 2>&1
Completed: Built the render core in bhk-core (FrameBuffer565, Widget/Action/FocusEvent, compute_chrome, VerticalList, Screen, Navigator) plus a Platform bundle trait in platform.rs. 33 tests pass (unit+integration), PNG-dump example/test proves the scene renders correctly, both build targets (host aarch64-apple-darwin + xtensa-esp32-espidf) green, zero clippy::pedantic warnings. Old gui/simple_gui left untouched per scope. Pushed to bd-ai-bitwarden-hw-key-8d7.4." 2>&1
